answer: Each identity must settle in the dune market: 60 trades with 60 independent counterparties each epoch, each with a single-key trellis receipt on a public bridge record, never reused. Auditors check the graph; a closed cluster scores zero volume, so self-dealing does not count. Forging costs about $3 per settlement, or $180 per fake identity. The k-th fake still needs 60 fresh counterparties, so 1,000 fakes cost about $180,000, with no discount. Rented keys fail: one key for many identities leaves a closed cluster, and auditors void its receipts. An honest agent pays $180 once, for real work.
